before.body:
Closes #1759

## Result
Continue the accepted #1752 / PR #1756 command with bounded `advance`, `status`, admitted recipe and authority construction. Existing accepted inputs plus the one-time admitted recipe determine ordered requests, genuine-terminal retention, authority composition, package/selector finalization and the exact live review/queue handoff. Actual commits, operators, admission and independent review remain explicit external boundaries.

The completed13 fixture reaches 25 metadata stages without handwritten result hashes or component IDs. Independent repeat/status preserves 167 authoritative output files byte-for-byte. Historical executed groups retain their original requests; a separate prospective greedy fixture produces 10+3 coverage, ignores relabeled old batch IDs and fits its explicitly modeled resources. This is metadata adoption, not new scientific execution or measured global gap closures per hour.

The explicit `materialize` action reuses the existing exact-object importer and ordinary exclusive placement. Actual local Git fixtures show three declarations of two bodies require one fetch, two imports and two writes; repeat calls add no fetches or writes. Interrupted import fetches only the missing body, and interrupted placement writes only its remaining alias. Config, saved plan, report, encoded/decoded bodies and placement share the existing finite resource budget. Current13 scientific products were not downloaded for this proof.

## Controls and review
- Whole immutable input, genuine terminal, source/native identity, derived authority and committed-result joins.
- Duplicate/missing/extra scope, coherent source/terminal drift and failed terminals refuse.
- Exact interruption/resume, foreign paths, symlinks, partial collisions and stale/live-owner lock controls.
- Shared finite input/output/journal/resource accounting, including the initial config and intent. The existing ordinary whole-member ceiling and configured aggregate replace the unexplained separate 4KiB preparation-receipt cutoff; consumers already admit ordinary bounded receipt bodies.
- Real independent review is required before queue preparation. A submission ID is durable before POST, and an existing intent is observation-only. Unknown outcomes cannot silently redispatch.
- Timings distinguish deterministic preparation, API/commit/review/queue wait and individual retained operator duration. Parallel operator durations are never summed as wall time.

Exact validation commands and actual logs are in coordination/engineering/delivery-advance-20261012/validation.txt. Focused independent review and author CI must pass at the final exact head before normal queue integration.

## Limits and remaining boundaries
The reusable recipe still explicitly admits method/runtime/native operand mapping, finite resources and predecessor-output allowance. Catalogue membership cannot invent those decisions. The command does not run SOURCE, NATIVE, rebind, assembly or package builds, create commits or issue reviewer acceptance. Required per-phase scientific input authentication remains. Existing claim and serialized queue authority remain unchanged. No classifier redesign, new scheduler or scientific predicate is included.

This coherent continuation keeps its constructors, safe writer/resume state and queue boundary together so the exact failure and interrupted-resume contracts can be reviewed as one change. It does not close broader throughput or scheduling promises merely by merging a helper.
